title: Content types: overview film
description: All 244 elements, sorted into 10 groups. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 53 seconds: the 244 content elements of Desiderio for TYPO3 v14 in 10 groups, from heroes and navigation to dashboards, forms and footers. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: A new client page often starts as a design file, and someone rebuilds it as templates.
Desiderio ships 244 content elements for TYPO3 v14, sorted into 10 groups by what a page needs.
Heroes, navigation, editorial layouts, features, pricing, trust, people, dashboards, leads and footers.
Each group page shows its elements live, in its own theme preset.
Every element has a backend preview, a dark mode and the colours of the chosen preset.
All 244 elements are in the free package.
